source: Bybit V5 public API via Cloudflare Worker + D1

early_scan.screening_method: 10m/30m/60m changes plus closed 5m/15m candles for top five

pattern_watch.note: Partial/batched H1 coverage. Counts are batch or rolling coverage, not full-universe fresh indicator coverage.

pattern_learning.reward_rule: +1 if gross +8% reached first; -1 if gross -4% reached first; 0 if neither in 24 completed future 1h bars
pattern_learning.goal_7d_rule: +1 if gross +30% reached first; -1 if gross -12% reached first; 0 if neither within 168 complete future 1h bars
pattern_learning.note: Observational tracking of selected top-ranked watches; no baseline, no proof of profitability, no live threshold adaptation.

ai_learning.methodology: Only CONDITIONAL observations. Full closed H1 candle confirms trigger; assume next H1 open paper entry; model technical target/stop; 24h and 7d from observation. No trigger=no entry. Both touched same hour=ambiguous. Gap>2%=skip. 0.30% illustrative round-trip costs. Not actual fill or validated profitability.

ai_decision_learning.evaluation_definition: 24h +8/-4 and 7d +30/-12 evaluated from Bybit ask snapshot, not conditional entry fills. Does NOT measure actual strategy P&L. Costs assumed 0.15% per side. Only contiguous complete H1 bars. No performance claim.
